blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Converge ICT Solutions Inc. has abandoned its earlier plans to build its next major data center in the Visayas or Mindanao, instead scouting locations in Calabarzon for new facilities as it seeks to capitalize on the artificial intelligence (AI) boom. Converge cofounder and CEO Dennis Uy said the fiber broadband provider is planning two additional data centers, with Cavite, Laguna, and Batangas among the potential locations. These would add to its existing facilities in Pampanga and Metro Manila. READ: Converge data center gets ‘green lane’ tag At the same time, Uy said one of the proposed facilities could […]...
